title: ceiba erianthos
intro: Ceiba erianthos, commonly known as Kapok, is a tropical tree native to Central and South America. Kapok is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Kapok include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. Additionally, the therapeutic actions of Kapok also include its ability to act as a natural antihistamine, helping to reduce itching and irritation.
